beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Two cubed: three twos multiplied together make eight.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Two is the base. The raised three is the exponent.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Two squared. Divide by two: four. Half the height.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Two to the first. Divide by two: two.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The exponent drops by one; the height halves. What happens at exponent zero?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Divide two by two. One. Height one, not zero.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Two to the negative one.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Divide one by two. One half.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Two to the negative two.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Divide by two again. One fourth.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The exponents pass zero. These heights stay positive, never reaching the floor.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Read that last step as a journey from one. Divide once. Divide twice.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Two divisions put two twos underneath the one: one over two squared.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: That is the reciprocal of four: the number that multiplies by four to make one.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: With base *a*, negative *n* counts divisions: one over *a* to the power *n*.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The base cannot be zero: dividing by zero is undefined.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Negative three, in parentheses, to the negative third.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Keep the minus inside. The denominator has three factors of negative three.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Start at one. Multiply by negative three: negative three.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Times negative three again: positive nine. Once more: negative twenty-seven.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The reciprocal is negative one twenty-seventh. Its minus comes from the base.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: For four fifths to the negative fourth, divide by four fifths four times.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Dividing by four fifths means multiplying by five fourths. Swap top and bottom.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Four divisions give four factors of five fourths.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Four fives multiply on top. Four fours multiply underneath.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Five to the fourth: six hundred twenty-five. Four to the fourth: two hundred fifty-six.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Six hundred twenty-five over two hundred fifty-six.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One staircase. The same division at every step, even as the exponent passes zero.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A negative exponent means divide by the base, as many times as it says.
